events.text: Air Wing SEVEN became permanently assigned to USS Dwight D. Eisenhower.

events.quote: On 1 March 1978 , Air Wing SEVEN became permanently assigned to USS Dwight D . Eisenhower

events.text: The air wing deployed for IKE's maiden Mediterranean voyage.

events.text: The air wing embarked for an Indian Ocean deployment in support of operations to rescue the hostages in Tehran.

events.quote: From April through December 1980 , the air wing embarked for an Indian Ocean deployment

events.text: The Indian Ocean deployment ended in December 1980.

events.text: The air wing took part in NATO exercises in the North Atlantic in September and October.
